1. (Currently Amended) An assembly comprising a test tube with a light-activated MTP affixed thereto, wherein the MTP is configured to be read by light activation rather than RF energy.

2. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the light-activated MTP is embedded in the test tube.

3. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the light-activated MTP is embedded underneath the bottom surface of the test tube, oriented for reading downwards via light activation.

4. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the test tube is a biorepository test tube configured for long-term sample storage.

5. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the light-activated MTP is embedded in polypropylene or acetal polymer material.

6. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the light-activated MTP is embedded near the center bottom of the container in a light-transmissive region.

(Currently Amended) A system for storing samples comprising the assembly of claim 1, and one or more of the following: a rack for biorepository test tubes with light-activation capability; an automated robot for moving racks or biorepository test tubes equipped with light-activation reading apparatus; and an automated sampling device adapted to sample said racks or biorepository test tubes using light-activation reading.

14. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 13 adapted for low temperature operation, such that the racks/test tubes are handled at -20°C or less while maintaining light-activation reading capability.

15. (Currently Amended) A method of forming a test tube assembly of claim 1, comprising embedding a light-activated MTP in plastic by heating the light-activated MTP to above the melting point of the plastic and melting a portion of the plastic with the heated light-activated MTP.

16. (Currently Amended) A method of reading a light-activated MTP embedded in a test tube assembly of claim 1, comprising: providing an embedded light-activated MTP; and reading the light-activated MTP using light activation.

17. (Original) The method of reading of claim 16, wherein the embedding material is frost coated.

18. (Original) The method of claim 16, wherein the reader comprises a vial receptacle and wherein vial receptacle and the embedded light-activated MTP are maintained at a temperature of -20°C or less.

19. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 4, wherein the light-activated MTP is embedded in polypropylene or acetal polymer.

20. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 19, wherein the light-activated MTP is embedded near the center bottom of the container in a light-transmissive region.
